verdict.rationale: Fin is built to act on its own once configured. Procedures handle multi-step queries with business logic and third-party systems end to end, and Fin can take actions that update external systems. Supporting evidence is a 'Manage your Fin workflows' article, Fin Tasks, webhook event subscriptions, and Insights that continuously analyzes every conversation. However, most of this is marketing copy or help-article titles, and the automations shown are triggered by customer conversations rather than general user-defined background jobs. missing for 10: documented detail on configuring triggers, schedules, or event-driven background workflows; evidence of automations beyond customer-conversation handling; independent or hands-on corroboration.
